items.headline: Asherton Harlborough made his senior debut for Northshire Town and held his own against experienced opposition
Cael Brindlewood scored his first professional goal, a low drive into the far corner that silenced the away end
items.managerQuote: We knew he had that in him. A quiet lad but a real eye for goal.

items.headline: Northshire Town are champions — a first title in the club's history
Emeka Thorne reached ten league goals in a single season for the first time in his career
Seren Voss signed a contract extension, committing to the club through the end of next season
The long-standing partnership between Harlborough and Voss in the spine of the side drew notice from opposition managers
